title: Counting points on braid varieties and the Deligne--Simpson problem
summary: We solve the isoclinic Deligne--Simpson problem for exceptional groups, completing a program initiated by Sage et al. and Jakob--Yun. As a by-product, we obtain new examples of physically rigid irregular connections on the projective line. Our approach uses the Riemann--Hilbert correspondence to reduce the problem to determining the non-emptiness of certain braid varieties associated to periodic braids.
